source.mutability: The composition pins an immutable official repository commit. Generation also verifies that the current main document is byte-identical, so a new vendor revision fails closed until consciously upgraded.

_extract.compatibility_effective_urls: Version 1 used https://api.hellosign.com/v3 plus doc-relative paths. Version 2 uses the origin-only https://api.hellosign.com base plus explicit /v3 paths, preserving every effective URL.

auth.selected: HTTP Basic API key supplied only by the enrolled Dropbox Sign connection
auth.oauth_note: The one-click recued-core enrollment accelerator selects Basic API-key auth. A manually enrolled OAuth bearer connection can supply the same ingredient without exposing tokens as operation arguments.

source_decision.reason: No live Dropbox Sign connection was available for the empirical field-presence and version-signal proof required by the authoring guide. OpenAPI shape alone is not used to claim a synchronized Source.

exclusions.reason: The official DELETE /fax_line route requires a JSON request body. The current REST binding deliberately does not serialize DELETE bodies, so an empty or query-substituted call would be non-executable.
This unauthenticated bootstrap route requires OAuth client_secret and authorization-code inputs. Credentials belong to the enrolled connection, never recipe arguments.
This unauthenticated bootstrap route exchanges refresh-token credentials and publishes a query marker inside the OpenAPI path. Connection-owned OAuth refresh must handle it outside an API operation.

The response embeds complete signed documents as data URIs in JSON. Publishing it would route document bytes through operation values instead of the isolated file_ref capture boundary; the binary download and expiring file-URL operations remain available.
